what: Selector pill — the pill’s leading end reaches the pressed button first in .35s and the trailing end follows .05s later in .55s, so the pill stretches long while crossing and then shrinks again (power3.out). The chosen button’s text turns to the background color in .3s

options.ease: Curve — a GSAP name or ”0.215,0.61,0.355,1”, default power3.out
options.[data-fx-part=option]: Button to pick (child) — aria-pressed=The one that is true is the starting position
options.[data-fx-part=pill]: Pill (child, created by the part if missing)
options.fx:pick: Event raised from the element when an item is selected (detail.index)

note: The exact lengths of the original lead and trail could not be read from the bundle constants (r.lead, r.trail), so the values are matched by eye

from.where: index.html .pm-seg price monthly/yearly · picking a distortion type (original Pricing’s edges lead·trail)
